job.title: [Post] Bhargavi Mocharla
job.email_subject: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – 5+ years Hybris 2105/2211, SAP Certified
job.email_body:
Dear Bhargavi Mocharla,

I saw your SAP Commerce Cloud post – I bring 5+ years of Hybris 2105 and 2211 development for Rockwell Automation and Shell, SAP certified. What I bring in concrete terms:

– OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA and third-party consumers
– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration
– Promotions Engine, OMS, Impex, FlexibleSearch; CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST web services for headless storefronts, Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Impex and FlexibleSearch, and PIM / ERP / MDM integrations with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, supports production, performs code reviews and works in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Your post targets exactly my core profile: SAP Commerce Cloud. I have spent more than five years building and extending Hybris 2105 and 2211 platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, from OCC APIs to PIM/ERP integrations and CCv2 releases. I want to bring that depth to an SAP Commerce project where reliable delivery matters, and I am open to roles across Germany.

en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
en.hook: Your post is looking for SAP Commerce Cloud talent who can deliver on real enterprise projects from day one of the engagement. That is exactly what I have done for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and extend B2B and B2C platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) with Java and Spring – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on Hybris 2211; developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch at Shell.

bullets.label: OCC APIs & headless
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Integrations
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams.

bullets.label: CCv2 & production
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, and supported production issues and code reviews.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a short conversation about the role and how I can strengthen your client's SAP Commerce team.
